description: This file is a bootstrap script for the Notesnook project, handling dependency management, package installation, and build processes for various project scopes and packages.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a shell command within a specified directory, capturing stdout and stderr.

methods.name: bootstrapPackage
methods.description: Installs and prepares a package, including rebuilding native modules and running postinstall scripts.

methods.name: findDependencies
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies of a given package scope, including nested dependencies.

methods.name: filterDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies that are local file references.

methods.name: needsRebuild
methods.description: Checks if native modules need rebuilding based on scripts in package.json.

methods.name: hasScript
methods.description: Checks if a package.json contains a specific script.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input via command line.

methods.name: analyzeDependencyMap
methods.description: Analyzes dependency versions across the monorepo and prompts for version consistency.
